title: The map on dual-number tangent vectors induced by a morphism is linear
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $f:X\to Y$ a morphism of $k$-schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $x\in X$ and $y=f(x)$, such that the induced map of residue fields $\kappa(y)\to\kappa(x)$ [def-weil-residue-field] is an isomorphism; identify $\kappa(y)$ with $\kappa=\kappa(x)$ through it, and accordingly the dual numbers $\kappa(y)[\epsilon]$ with $\kappa[\epsilon]$ [def-sc-dual-numbers]. Let $T_X$ and $T_Y$ be the $\kappa$-vector spaces of morphisms $\operatorname{Spec}\kappa[\epsilon]\to X$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] at $x$, resp. $\operatorname{Spec}\kappa[\epsilon]\to Y$ at $y$, given by [lem-sc-tangent-space-vector-space]. Then for every $\theta\in T_X$ the composite $f\circ\theta$ lies in $T_Y$, and $\theta\mapsto f\circ\theta$ is a $\kappa$-linear map $T_X\to T_Y$.
